methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Robotics & Manufacturing (found 0 same-stage, 0 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 10 same-sector peers exist in Robotics & Manufacturing, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

data.narrative:
Neuromeka is a publicly listed robotics and manufacturing company on KOSDAQ, having raised $36.5M to date. The valuation universe comprises a modest comp set of nine peers: one public company (ticker 277810.KQ) and eight private firms including Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, Generalist AI, and Bedrock Robotics. This narrow peer universe reflects the fragmented landscape of robotics and manufacturing technology.

The peer-median method proved inapplicable due to insufficient comparable datapoints. Although ten same-sector peers exist in robotics and manufacturing, applying standard filters—same-stage, adjacent-stage, and similar-valuation-tier classification—yielded fewer than three datapoints in any meaningful subset. A broad cross-sector median would introduce unacceptable comparability noise and was therefore excluded from the analysis.

The absence of a statistically robust peer-multiple baseline limits triangulation to other methods not detailed in the provided dataset. Without peer-based anchoring, valuation relies on alternative approaches such as discounted cash flow analysis or revenue-multiple derivation from the broader private comp set, though applicability depends on data availability for those nine peers. Key uncertainties include Neuromeka's current financial performance relative to comparable-stage robotics companies and the degree to which its public listing status (versus private peer positioning) warrants valuation adjustment. Additional analysis of the single public peer and deeper diligence on the eight private firms would be necessary to establish a defensible valuation range.
